description: Op-shaped job that walks the live Dagster asset graph and pushes lineage + metadata to OpenMetadata's REST API (service → database → schemas → tables → lineage edges). Idempotent PUTs.

tags.label: Job Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags as key-value pairs.

api_token_env.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env.description: Env var holding the JWT bearer token. Generate one in OpenMetadata under Settings → Bots.

service_name.label: Service Name
service_name.description: OpenMetadata DatabaseService name to ensure-exist + parent the asset graph under.

database_name.label: Database Name
database_name.description: OpenMetadata Database name under the service.

verify_ssl.label: Verify SSL
verify_ssl.description: Verify TLS cert. Set false for self-signed dev OpenMetadata.

only_export_on_change.label: Only Export on Change
only_export_on_change.description: Hash the structural payload and skip push when unchanged from the previous successful run.

fail_on_catalog_error.label: Fail on Catalog Error
fail_on_catalog_error.description: If true, fail the run when the catalog is unreachable or PUTs error. Default true.
